ownerRequestedDefinition: One caregiver supports two people in the same home.

officialSources.supports: FirstLight discusses working with couples, supporting each spouse and respecting individual needs. Does not establish a national one-caregiver-for-two policy.
Individually considered personal-care tasks and capacity; exact services vary by location and local assessment/pricing.
Official site search was checked in addition to several indexed searches. No exact national couples-care definition was located in these results.

publicWording: One caregiver supports two people in the same home when their individual needs can be safely met together. Each person needs a separate assessment; one caregiver may not be enough for simultaneous hands-on needs. Rates vary by local office.
limitation: The one-caregiver-for-two arrangement comes from the owner brief and is presented as conditional draft copy, not a confirmed national FirstLight service definition or a claim that every office offers it. Local staffing and availability require confirmation.
quiz: New who=couple option; still eight questions. Remaining answers describe the person with greater needs; benefits reviewed individually.
